title: quercus sessiliflora subsp. polycarpa
intro: Quercus sessiliflora subsp. polycarpa, commonly known as the Mexican white oak, is a subspecies of evergreen tree in the beech family, Fagaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as therapeutic actions like soothing digestive issues and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of Quercus sessiliflora subsp. polycarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, its extracts have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular diseases.
